source_integrity.summary: Exact pending and both staged Git blobs at initial reviewed commit and current parent matched; prior-ready revision 1, prior revision 0 rejection retained.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: Registered daily-global-macro, brief/daily and existing program, dimensions, topics, global geography and war-armed-conflict phenomenon; no invented taxonomy.

research_depth.summary: Both locales exceed 1700-word daily floor (1858 EN, 2172 PT-BR after stripping fences and links); five analytical numbered sections plus executive assessment and references; supplier revenue recognition, metal profitability concentration, financing contracts, sampled flows versus securities transactions, currency/energy constraints, scenarios and observable falsifiers. Revision addresses original depth shortfall.

evidence_traceability.summary: Rechecked NBS 27 Nov releases including 16% YTD profit, 6.7% revenue, 6.2% costs, 5.69% margin and metals 60.2/71.7% plus 4.6 pp contribution; BoE 26 Nov FSR section 1.2 confirms >$305bn projected bond issuance and >$4tn potential exposure including debt and commitments, not losses; BEA 25 Nov PCE/GDP, INE flash CPI, Tokyo CPI and Reuters/LSEG flow figures corroborated. Reuters early market and oil prints corroborated through timestamped syndication (London South East 09:26 UTC and Yahoo/RTE 09:56/10:22 UTC respectively). NBS official indexed extracts corroborated through original-source reproductions when direct page fetch failed.

factual_methodology.summary: Profit growth is comparable-basis industrial enterprise data, not all firms; flow sample is fund subscriptions/redemptions, not all cross-border transactions; exposure estimates not expected losses; annual CPI and annualized GDP distinguished, energy loss not independently quantified.

counterfactual_review.summary: Alternative input prices, operating leverage and mix; existing purchase contracts and cash-generative borrowers can sustain demand; narrower credit spreads, durable paid demand and broadening profitability would weaken concentration thesis. No inference that AI alone causes metal profit or that a specific investor transferred capital across regions.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two charts match numerically: [16,6.7,6.2] and [-30.57,-2.75,7.29,-22.73]; overlapping total explicitly non-additive; one four-row inflation table with definitions, one conditional flow and one qualitative exposure map per locale; dated units and source links.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: Read both locales; all 12 references, numeric series, dates, definitions, uncertainties, scenarios and conditional mechanisms match.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: 11:42 UTC cutoff; 27 Nov Asian and European releases and 09:26 UTC Reuters market syndication, 09:35 oil observation and 09:42 Lipper publication before cutoff; earlier BEA and BoE releases contextual. No later US cash-market close used.

geographic_neutrality.summary: Lead based on cross-border production and financing rather than fixed national sections; prior 25–26 Nov tariff and GDP/PCE coverage distinguished from new profit/credit/flow signals; explicit conditional energy transmission to emerging importers. Not an exhaustive region dashboard.

system_registry_reconciliation.summary: Revision 1 reconciliation 2026-11-27-mt-gm-2026-11-27-revision-1-publication-reconciliation recorded decisions for all seven required assets; prior omission corrected.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Previous revision 0 rejection resolved: substantive English depth, seven-asset reconciliation, and clarification of debt versus contingent commitments; exact source parity and dated references.

editorial_style.summary: Institutional, mechanism-led, separates empirical observation and scenarios, no promotional or conversational framing.

publication_snapshot_integrity.summary: Complete pending object embedded unmodified; both source SHAs and pending blob bound to reviewed commit.

contrary_evidence: Supplier profitability can reflect commodity prices, energy transition, product mix and operating leverage rather than AI alone.
Cash-generative firms with contracted capacity may sustain investment despite selective credit tightening.
Holiday-thinned equity rebounds and divergent European fund inflows contradict uniform flight from risk.
limitations: Primary NBS URL fetch failed in browser; exact official indexed releases and reproductions corroborated the claims.
Reuters syndicated reports are one reporting origin, not independent corroboration.
No complete synchronized global market or labour panel; physical oil losses unverified.
BoE contractual exposure is potential, not expected losses; funding and industrial transmission conditional.
No full repository CI or live publication asserted by this QA.
notes: Fresh QA of prior-ready revision 1. Revision 0 rejection preserved. No source changes or public promotion; later publisher must revalidate exact blob tuple.

signal_rationale.delta: Compared with 26 November tariff proposals and GDP/PCE, the new delta is NBS industrial profits, Bank of England 26 November quantified AI-credit exposure, 27 November fund flows and contrasting inflation releases. Tariffs are not the lead.
signal_rationale.evidence: NBS 27 November official data; BoE Financial Stability Report 26 November; LSEG Lipper via Reuters 27 November; Japan Statistics Bureau and INE 27 November; Reuters oil and early markets. NBS separate interpretation quantifies non-ferrous metals contribution to profit growth (4.6 percentage points).
signal_rationale.scale_path: AI demand and contracts support financing and supplier orders; financing repricing can affect new orders before current profits fall.
signal_rationale.transmission: Expected AI returns → contract-backed debt and equity → data centre investment → equipment orders and industrial profit; energy and inflation constrain monetary offsets.
signal_rationale.falsifier: Durable improvement in paid AI demand and cash flow, narrower credit spreads, diversified industrial profitability and sustained fund inflows weaken the thesis.

key_constraints: Market data intraday; US cash session not closed.
Fund flows are sampled, not total capital flows.
BoE exposure includes contingent contractual commitments, not losses.
Tokyo and Spain inflation definitions differ.
Physical oil losses not independently verified.

producer_checks.novelty_decision: New industrial profit and financial stability evidence supports a distinct lead.

source_audit.added_source: NBS 27 Nov interpretation: non-ferrous mining +60.2%, smelting and rolling +71.7%, combined 4.6 pp contribution to aggregate industrial profit growth; not attributable to AI alone.
